For the first time ever, i have been able to create a literal $SOL bank where you can take out a loan from @BankRoll_Sol 
 
This is the entire idea behind Bankroll.
Crypto holders constantly run into the same problem: you can have significant value sitting in a token, but the moment you need liquidity, your only real option is to sell it.
So, i built a system that lets $Bank
 holders use their tokens as collateral instead.
How does it work?
- Deposit $SOL into Bankroll as collateral.
- Choose how much SOL you want to borrow against it.
- The platform calculates your collateral position, interest and repayment terms.
- Every loan request goes through operator approval before SOL leaves the treasury.
- Your $Bank remains locked for the duration of the loan.
Repay the principal + accrued interest and the collateral is released back to your wallet.
The important part is how the treasury works.
Instead of relying entirely on external lenders to provide the SOL, the Bankroll treasury is designed to be funded by trading fees generated by $BANK.
A portion of that SOL remains liquid so approved loans can be funded.
SOL that isn't currently required for lending can be deployed into JitoSOL, allowing surplus treasury reserves to continue generating yield rather than sitting idle.
Then, as loans are repaid, the principal returns to the lending pool while interest and fees add additional revenue back into the treasury.
So you have trading activity funding the treasury, treasury capital funding loans, idle reserves generating yield and loan repayments recycling liquidity back into the system.
But borrowing is only one side of Bankroll.
We have also built an OTC agent locator where users can search for local crypto ↔ cash providers by city, currency, token, payment method, fees and transaction limits.
The next layer is spending.
The proposed Bankroll card would connect available balances to a card provider, while the gift card system is designed to let users spend available SOL with supported merchants.
The end goal is very simple:
Deposit $Bank → borrow SOL → use that liquidity → repay the loan → unlock your $BANK.
One platform connecting collateral, liquidity and real-world spending without requiring the holder to sell the underlying token.
Yes, we are building our very own $SOL bank, with a card & an ATM.
This has taken very long to build, but its all legit and you will see the first ever bank, for loaning SOL take place ALL on chain. All funded by $BANK.

ShibaBrain is a Shiba with a real brain.

Under her fur runs a complete connectome, the full wiring map of a real brain: 158,262 neurons and about 3 million synapses, simulated live in your browser while you watch. Nothing about her is scripted. When she trots, stops, turns or sniffs, neurons fired first.

Her job: she walks the top coins one by one and gives each a verdict. Every decision on the ticker comes from her own neurons reacting to what is in front of her, not from a script and not from a human.

Watch her think. The brain readout on screen shows the neurons firing as she decides.


$SHIBABRAIN is a community coin. Not financial advice.
